## Result

Describe the changed behavior, accepted decision or planning correction.

## Linked work

Refs #

## Evidence and validation

List checks actually run, results and evidence required by the issue's acceptance gate. Distinguish planning checks, source proof, implementation tests and production readback.

## Scope and policy impact

Identify affected metric definitions, mappings, privacy rules, source permissions or operating decisions. State remaining acceptance work before using a closing keyword.

## Source and migration record

Link public source documentation or the exact synthetic fixture for changed assumptions. For metric or contract changes, identify old/new definition versions, same-dataset comparison, data migration or replay/backfill, rollback and historical compatibility. If not applicable, explain why. Do not paste private payloads or credentials.

## Review routing

Name the affected metric, ingestion, UI, security or operations review role and the existing designated owner/review rule, where configured. Do not infer a person from a proposed plan role. Policy changes need designated review before activation; a passing test or PR alone is not production policy approval.
